subject: Procurement orientation: vendor onboarding staffing & availability
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <anguyen@novushealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T15:10:00Z
Subject: Vendor procurement orientation & initial availability

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks for taking the time to engage on our upcoming vendor evaluation for Q3. Procurement and engineering at Novus Health would like to run an orientation session next week to understand Redwood's onboarding steps, timelines, and the specific data/security handoffs we'll need.

High-level requests for the session:
- Who from Redwood will cover procurement/contracting vs technical onboarding?
- A brief walkthrough of the vendor onboarding checklist and expected evidence (SOC 2, data retention, access logs).
- Timeline for provisioning a private environment (if needed) and any lead times for Dedicated capacity.

Attached is our RFP excerpt for section 2 (vendor requirements) — this will help focus the orientation.

Available times (Novus local timezone): Tue 9–11am, Wed 1–4pm, Thu 10–12pm. Let me know what works.

Best,
Alex
Senior Platform Engineer
Novus Health

Attachment: NOVA_RFP_Q3.pdf (excerpt)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <anguyen@novushealth.com>, Samantha Price <s.price@novushealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor procurement orientation & initial availability

Alex — really appreciate the RFP excerpt, this is perfect.

We can run a combined procurement + technical orientation. Proposed attendees from Redwood: myself (AE) to coverProcurement/pricing, Marissa (Solutions Lead) for commercial, Diego (SE) for the technical onboarding and network prerequisites.

Draft agenda (30–45 minutes):
- 5m: intros and goals
- 10m: procurement/onboarding checklist & timeline (contracts, redlines, evidence)
- 10m: deployment options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and estimated lead times
- 15m: technical prerequisites & next steps (network, SSO, KMS)

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-09-01 16:00–17:00 PT
- Wed 2026-09-02 11:00–12:00 PT
- Thu 2026-09-03 09:00–10:00 PT

If none of those work, share a couple of your team's best windows and we'll adapt.

I'm attaching our procurement checklist so Novus procurement can see what evidence we normally produce.

Thanks — Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-procurement-checklist.pdf

From: Samantha Price <s.price@novushealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Nguyen <anguyen@novushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>, Dave Milton <d.milton@novushealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor procurement orientation & initial availability

Hi Rishi / team — thanks for the quick reply.

We can do Wed 2026-09-02 11:00–12:00 PT. That slot works for procurement and Alex's team. I'll draft a calendar invite once you confirm the final attendee list.

A couple of housekeeping items ahead of the orientation:
- Please have a single point of contact for security evidence requests (SOC 2, encryption at rest details, where audit logs are stored).
- We'll circulate our procurement questionnaire; can you review and flag any items that need Redwood legal input? (Link: https://redwood.example.com/procurement/questionnaire/novus-4579)

Also — are you able to provide an estimated timeline for a Private deployment (if we choose that route) and any lead time expectations for Dedicated GPU capacity?

Thanks,
Samantha Price
Sr. Procurement Manager, Novus Health

Note: I'll need SOC 2 scope details before we finalize the PoC procurement docs.

From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Price <s.price@novushealth.com>, Alex Nguyen <anguyen@novushealth.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-31T12:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor procurement orientation & initial availability

Thanks Samantha — 11:00 PT on Wed 9/2 works for me. I'll plan to cover the technical onboarding section and can walk through network/IP allowlists, SSO/SAML flow, KMS integration patterns, and sample timing for Dedicated capacity.

Pre-reqs for a productive session:
- Primary network contact (name + email) for Novus so we can discuss firewall/allowlist windows.
- Any current cloud VPC architecture diagram (high level).
- If you anticipate a private deployment, please flag expected data residency requirements.

Attachment: network-prereqs.txt (short checklist)

I'll keep the technical portion to about 15 minutes and save 15 minutes for Q&A / next steps.

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Price <s.price@novushealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T16:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor procurement orientation & initial availability

Rishi — quick note: please include a CS/Onboarding rep on the invite (I recommend adding Monica or Evelyn depending on availability) so we can ensure the post-contract staging steps are covered.

Also recommend making the session 60 minutes with a 30-minute technical breakout after the general orientation if Novus wants to dive deeper — mark the calendar as 60 min and add a 30 min optional technical deep-dive block.

Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations

(On a separate note to the team: if this looks like it may convert quickly, flag for a Dedicated capacity readiness review with infra so we can pre-reserve capacity windows.)
